pages.text:
Carry power, liquids, gases and heat in your inventory. Each comes in four tiers; better tiers hold four times as much and move it four times as fast.
- Battery: FE. Drain it in an Energy Cell's top slot, charge it in the bottom one.
- Canister: one liquid. Empty it in a Fluid Tank's top slot, fill it in the bottom one. It won't take gases.
- Gas Cartridge: one gas. Use a Pressurized Cylinder's slots.
- Thermal Capsule: heat. Use a Heat Cell's slots. Heat only flows from hotter to colder, and a capsule leaks while you carry it.
The bar under the item shows how full it is. Upgrading one to the next tier keeps what it holds.
